preconditions.description: The number of towns n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of different types of goods k is between 1 and the minimum of n and 100 inclusive.
The number of different types of goods necessary to hold a fair s is between 1 and k inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= k for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each town produces a type of goods a_i that is between 1 and k inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct towns u and v, both between 1 and n inclusive.
The list of goods types a has exactly n elements.
The list of roads has exactly m elements.

postconditions.description: The output result contains exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result[i] <= n-1 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each number in the result is between 0 and n-1 inclusive, representing the minimum travel expenses.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(a[u-1] for u in path)) >= s for i in range(n) for path in paths if path[0] == i)
postconditions.description: For each town i, there exists a path starting from i that includes at least s different types of goods.
